faqData.q: What is your main area of expertise?
faqData.a: I specialize at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, Full-stack Development (Next.js & Node.js), and Blockchain/Web3 technologies.

faqData.q: Are you available for research or freelance collaborations?
faqData.a: I am active in AI research and always open to innovative freelance projects, internships, or technical collaborations.

faqData.q: What is your typical tech stack for production?
faqData.a: For AI, Python with TensorFlow, PyTorch, and YOLO. For web, the T3 stack: Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

faqData.q: Do you have experience with enterprise or lab projects?
faqData.a: Yes, as a System Analyst and AI Developer in research-driven environments, including AIoT platforms and attack detection systems.

faqData.q: How can we start a partnership or project?
faqData.a: Use the contact form above or reach out directly by email. I usually respond within 24 hours.
